sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是隐性大脑。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: In the famous children's fairy tale, The Ugly Duckling,
sentences.zh: 在著名的儿童童话《丑小鸭》中，

sentences.en: a mother duck lays a clutch of eggs.
sentences.zh: 母鸭生了一窝蛋。

sentences.en: When the hatchlings emerge, one is different from the reSt.
sentences.zh: 当小鸭子破壳而出时，有一只与众不同。

sentences.en: He is huge and awkward-looking.
sentences.zh: 他又大又笨拙。

sentences.en: His feathers are not yellow or black, but a muted gray.
sentences.zh: 他的羽毛不是黄色或黑色的，而是一种柔和的灰色。

sentences.en: As soon as he's hatched, the bullying begins.
sentences.zh: 他刚孵化出来，霸凌就开始了。

sentences.en: Not only from his siblings, but other animals too.
sentences.zh: 不仅来自他的兄弟姐妹，还有其他动物。

sentences.en: And so the ugly duckling roams the countryside,
sentences.zh: 于是丑小鸭在乡间游荡，

sentences.en: slowly accepting his fate of being an outcaSt.
sentences.zh: 渐渐接受了自己被排挤的命运。

sentences.en: Then, one day, he sees a flock of swans.
sentences.zh: 直到有一天，他看到了一群天鹅。

sentences.en: Entranced by their beauty, he swims toward them.
sentences.zh: 他被它们的美丽所吸引，向它们游去。

sentences.en: As he gets closer, he expects them to be disgusted by his appearance,
sentences.zh: 当他靠近时，他以为它们会厌恶他的外表，

sentences.en: just like all the other creatures he has encountered.
sentences.zh: 就像他遇到的所有其他生物一样。

sentences.en: But to his surprise, they welcome him with open wings.
sentences.zh: 但令他惊讶的是，它们张开翅膀欢迎他。

sentences.en: You know the rest of the story.
sentences.zh: 故事的后续你都知道。

sentences.en: The flock of swans sees the duckling for what he truly is,
sentences.zh: 这群天鹅看到了小鸭子的真实面目，

sentences.en: a young swan who will grow up to be as beautiful as the rest of them.
sentences.zh: 一只长大后和它们一样美丽年轻的天鹅。

sentences.en: I've long had misgivings about this story.
sentences.zh: 我长期以来一直对这个故事存有疑虑。

sentences.en: What is its moral?
sentences.zh: 它的寓意是什么？

sentences.en: If people don't look like they belong to our tribe, it's okay to treat them badly.
sentences.zh: 如果人们看起来不属于我们的族群，就可以虐待他们。

sentences.en: We can only find acceptance among people who are just like us.
sentences.zh: 我们只能在和我们相似的人群中找到接纳。

sentences.en: To be ugly is to be cursed.
sentences.zh: 丑陋就是一种诅咒。

sentences.en: In our episode last week, we explored the science of beauty,
sentences.zh: 在我们上周的节目中，我们探讨了美的科学，

sentences.en: why we are attracted to it, and how we are moved by it.
sentences.zh: 为什么我们会被它吸引，以及我们如何被它打动。

sentences.en: If you missed that episode, please do listen to it.
sentences.zh: 如果你错过了那一期，请一定要听听。

sentences.en: This week, we explore some of the more complicated elements of our fascination with beauty,
sentences.zh: 本周，我们探讨对美着迷中更复杂的一些元素，

sentences.en: especially beautiful people.
sentences.zh: 尤其是美丽的人。

sentences.en: From infancy, human beings are fascinated by those who are good-looking.
sentences.zh: 从婴儿时期起，人类就对长相好看的人着迷。

sentences.en: They are the stars of our movies and magazines, objects of our adoration.
sentences.zh: 他们是我们电影和杂志的明星，是我们崇拜的对象。

sentences.en: But our unthinking adulation of beauty can come with steep costs.
sentences.zh: 但我们对美的盲目崇拜可能会带来沉重的代价。

sentences.en: The Science of Beauty Bias, this week on Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 美貌偏见的科学，本周《隐性大脑》节目。

sentences.en: From a very young age, we are taught to see past people's looks.
sentences.zh: 从小到大，我们被教导要透过外表看本质。

sentences.en: We tell children, don't judge a book by its cover.
sentences.zh: 我们告诉孩子，不要以貌取人。

sentences.en: Beauty is only skin deep.
sentences.zh: 美只是表面的。

sentences.en: It's what's on the inside that counts.
sentences.zh: 内在美才最重要。

sentences.en: Growing up, Vivian Zias heard these aphorisms many times.
sentences.zh: 维维安·齐亚斯在成长过程中多次听到这些格言。

sentences.en: But when she was in graduate school, she found herself drawing a quick and unkind impression about a young student.
sentences.zh: 但当她在读研究生时，她发现自己对一名年轻学生迅速做出了不友善的印象。

sentences.en: My advisor came and he said, I have an undergraduate who wants to work in the lab and she would be great as a research assistant for you.
sentences.zh: 我的导师走过来对我说，我有一个本科生想在实验室工作，她非常适合做你的研究助理。

sentences.en: And so he introduces me to this student and she was really disheveled.
sentences.zh: 于是他把我介绍给这个学生，她看起来真的很邋遢。

sentences.en: Like, her hair wasn't, like, combed well, and she wasn't well put together.
sentences.zh: 比如，她的头发没有梳好，而且她也没有好好收拾自己。

sentences.en: Her appearance looked a little messy, and I was like, uh-oh.
sentences.zh: 她的外表看起来有点乱，当时我想，啊哦。

sentences.en: Vivian felt she was in a high-stakes setting.
sentences.zh: 维维安觉得她身处一个高风险的环境中。

sentences.en: She didn't want anyone on her team who wasn't top-notch.
sentences.zh: 她不希望她的团队里有任何并非顶尖的人。

sentences.en: Would this undergraduate be able to cut it?
sentences.zh: 这个本科生能胜任吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I can, I see it in my mind's eye.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我可以，我脑海中能浮现出那个画面。

sentences.en: They're standing there by the doorway into the lab,
sentences.zh: 他们正站在实验室门口，

sentences.en: and he just, you know, brings her and introduces her to me for the first time.
sentences.zh: 然后他，你知道的，把她带过来第一次介绍给我。

sentences.en: And I wasn't happy, but we worked together a lot.
sentences.zh: 我当时很不高兴，但我们合作了很多。

sentences.en: We worked together over the course of a year and she was socially warm and engaged.
sentences.zh: 我们在一年里一起工作，她非常热情、善于交际且投入。

sentences.en: She was very orderly and dutiful.
sentences.zh: 她非常有条理且尽责。

sentences.en: So she was able to meet all the requirements very quickly and did it well.
sentences.zh: 所以她能够非常快地满足所有要求并且做得很好。

sentences.en: And it turned out that she was one of the best research assistants I ended up having.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，她是我最终拥有的最好的研究助理之一。

sentences.en: She was excellent.
sentences.zh: 她太优秀了。

sentences.en: You know, my impression was so wrong that has stayed with me all these years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的印象大错特错，这多年来一直留在我的记忆中。

sentences.en: Did you ever apologize to her for your initial impressions of her?
sentences.zh: 你有没有因为最初对她的印象向她道歉？

sentences.en: I don't know if she registered it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她是否意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: And I think I was still, you know, polite.
sentences.zh: 而且我想我当时，你知道，还是很礼貌的。

sentences.en: I was definitely not rude.
sentences.zh: 我绝对没有粗鲁。

sentences.en: And I think I might have a judgment that is registered internally.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能在内心里有过评判。

sentences.en: And I don't know how much she picked up on that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她对此察觉了多少。

sentences.en: I would be doing a lot of apologizing if every time I made a judgment I was wrong, I had to apologize.
sentences.zh: 如果每次我做判断错了都要道歉，那我得道很多歉了。

sentences.en: Part of the reason the story has stayed with Vivian is that she went on to become a psychologist
sentences.zh: 这个故事一直留在维维安脑海中的部分原因在于，她后来成为了一名心理学家，

sentences.en: who studies the very mistakes she made with a young undergrad.
sentences.zh: 专门研究她对年轻本科生犯下的那些错误。

sentences.en: Vivian, who now works at Cornell University, would come to study the so-called beauty bias.
sentences.zh: 现就职于康奈尔大学的维维安，后来开始研究所谓的美貌偏见。

sentences.en: She says this bias involves leaping to a number of unsupported conclusions.
sentences.zh: 她说这种偏见涉及到仓促得出许多毫无根据的结论。

sentences.en: What is beautiful is good.
sentences.zh: 美丽就是美好。

sentences.en: And what is beautiful is also intelligent and popular and strong and competent and happy.
sentences.zh: 美丽同时也意味着聪明、受欢迎、强大、称职和快乐。

sentences.en: And so we usually when we judge someone as beautiful, we go way beyond the judgment of their physical appearance
sentences.zh: 所以通常当我们判断某人很美时，我们的判断远远超出了对外表的评价，

sentences.en: to making inferences about what they are like in a whole number of other domains.
sentences.zh: 进而推断他们在其他诸多领域的表现。

sentences.en: And so we think they have a lot of friends,
sentences.zh: 因此我们认为他们有很多朋友，

sentences.en: and they're really good parents, and they're a wonderful partner,
sentences.zh: 他们是非常好的父母，是非常棒的伴侣，

sentences.en: and they must have such fun when they go on vacation.
sentences.zh: 他们去度假时一定过得非常开心。

sentences.en: So we really overgeneralize way beyond what we should
sentences.zh: 所以我们确实过度概括了，远远超出了我们应该做到的程度，

sentences.en: based on the information that we're gleaning from just physical appearance.
sentences.zh: 仅仅基于我们从外表收集到的信息。

sentences.en: Vivian remembers another time she drew a quick inference about someone based on looks.
sentences.zh: 维维安记起了另一次她根据外表对某人做出快速推断的经历。

sentences.en: We have speakers give various academic talks.
sentences.zh: 我们邀请演讲者做各种学术演讲。

sentences.en: And often now to advertise the talk, you see the person's photograph.
sentences.zh: 现在为了宣传演讲，通常你会看到这个人的照片。

sentences.en: So their photograph is presented along with the title of their talk.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的照片会和演讲标题一起展示。

sentences.en: And I remember seeing there was a speaker coming in and seeing this person's photograph.
sentences.zh: 我记得看到有一位演讲者要来，看到了这个人的照片。

sentences.en: and I didn't think it was a very good photograph.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那张照片拍得不是很好。

sentences.en: But I remember I had a very strong reaction to the photograph,
sentences.zh: 但我记得我对这张照片有很强烈的反应，

sentences.en: which is kind of rare because often they're very standard pictures
sentences.zh: 这有点罕见，因为通常人们的照片都很标准，

sentences.en: that people have of themselves.
sentences.zh: 是他们自己拍的普通照片。

sentences.en: The person comes and gives a talk.
sentences.zh: 这个人来了并做了演讲。

sentences.en: And actually that photograph was so strong,
sentences.zh: 实际上那张照片给我的印象太深了，

sentences.en: it elicited such a strong reaction to me,
sentences.zh: 引发了我如此强烈的反应，

sentences.en: it was almost to the point where I was like,
sentences.zh: 几乎到了这种程度，我想，

sentences.en: how could this person give a good talk?
sentences.zh: 这个人怎么能做好演讲呢？

sentences.en: It was such a strong reaction.
sentences.zh: 这种反应太强烈了。

sentences.en: The person comes to visit, they give a talk, and they are the loveliest person.
sentences.zh: 这个人来参观，做了一场演讲，他们是极其可爱的人。

sentences.en: They are so authentic and engaging.
sentences.zh: 他们是如此真诚和引人入胜。

sentences.en: And that initial impression was erased.
sentences.zh: 最初的那个印象被抹去了。

sentences.en: And I think it really said a lot about the person and their talk and their energy during the talk that was able to kind of undo that initial impression.
sentences.zh: 我想这确实很能说明这个人的特质、他们的演讲以及演讲过程中的活力，这种活力能够某种程度上消除最初的印象。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And of course, what usually would happen is that we might look at a photograph,
sentences.zh: 当然，通常发生的情况是，我们可能会看一张照片，

sentences.en: reach an unconscious conclusion about that person and never attend that talk and never have that
sentences.zh: 对这个人得出无意识的结论，然后永远不会去听那场演讲，也永远不会让那个

sentences.en: impression corrected.
sentences.zh: 印象得到纠正。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: I think also sometimes it is harder to
sentences.zh: 我也觉得有时更难

sentences.en: correct for it.
sentences.zh: 去纠正这种印象。

sentences.en: I think in the case of the research assistant and the case of the speaker
sentences.zh: 我认为就研究助理和那个

sentences.en: giving their talk, they provided clear and diagnostic information that my initial impression
sentences.zh: 做演讲的发言人而言，他们提供了清晰且有说服力的信息，表明我最初的印象

sentences.en: was wrong.
sentences.zh: 是错误的。

sentences.en: And sometimes when we meet someone, they might not be able to provide that clear
sentences.zh: 有时当我们遇到某人时，他们可能无法提供那种清晰的

sentences.en: information that the impression is wrong.
sentences.zh: 信息来证明这种印象是错误的。

sentences.en: You know, some interactions are pretty mundane and
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些互动相当平淡，

sentences.en: you engage in small talk.
sentences.zh: 你只是在进行闲聊。

sentences.en: Perhaps in those conversations, there wouldn't be enough
sentences.zh: 也许在这些对话中，不会有足够的

sentences.en: disconfirming information to undo that initial impression.
sentences.zh: 反证信息来消除最初的印象。

sentences.en: In fact, the swift conclusions we draw about people
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们根据人们的长相

sentences.en: based on how they look can often be confirmed
sentences.zh: 对他们迅速做出的结论，往往会得到

sentences.en: by our perceptions of how they act.
sentences.zh: 我们对他们行为方式的看法的证实。

sentences.en: We are often on the lookout for evidence
sentences.zh: 我们经常在人们的行为举止中

sentences.en: in the way people behave
sentences.zh: 寻找证据，

sentences.en: that will back up our initial impressions.
sentences.zh: 来支持我们最初的印象。

sentences.en: Like heat-seeking missiles,
sentences.zh: 就像热寻导弹一样，

sentences.en: we zero in on any clues that suggest
sentences.zh: 我们会锁定任何暗示

sentences.en: that our biases are not biases, but facts.
sentences.zh: 我们的偏见不是偏见而是事实的线索。

sentences.en: Vivian remembers the time she saw the movie
sentences.zh: 维维安还记得她看电影

sentences.en: No Country for Old Men
sentences.zh: 《老无所依》的那次经历

sentences.en: It's based on the great novel by Cormac McCarthy
sentences.zh: 这是根据麦卡锡的伟大小说改编的

sentences.en: and it features a psychopathic killer
sentences.zh: 影片中有一个精神病杀手

sentences.en: named Anton Chigurh
sentences.zh: 名叫安东·齐格尔

sentences.en: Yeah, one thing that stuck with me
sentences.zh: 对，让我印象深刻的一件事

sentences.en: was his bow cut, right?
sentences.zh: 是他的锅盖头，对吧？

sentences.en: His haircut was just cut straight across
sentences.zh: 他的发型就是横着剪过去

sentences.en: straight down
sentences.zh: 笔直垂下

sentences.en: and I think the way that framed his face
sentences.zh: 我认为这种衬托他脸部的方式

sentences.en: was just, he looked like a psychopath
sentences.zh: 就是，他看起来就像个精神病患者

sentences.en: And so part of me thought that the way he looked was the way the actor looked.
sentences.zh: 所以我一部分心智认为他的外表就是那个演员本来的样子。

sentences.en: And so to me, I was like, well, that must be an easy role since the actor looks like that.
sentences.zh: 因此对我来说，我想，那一定是个容易的角色，因为演员长那样。

sentences.en: It's easy for him to play a psychopath.
sentences.zh: 他演精神病患者很容易。

sentences.en: Sometime later, Vivian was watching the Oscars.
sentences.zh: 过了一段时间，维维安在看奥斯卡颁奖典礼。

sentences.en: The actor who played Anton Chigurh was up for an award.
sentences.zh: 饰演安东·齐格尔的演员入围了奖项。

sentences.en: And Vivian realized she had pictured him all wrong.
sentences.zh: 维维安意识到她把他的形象完全想象错了。

sentences.en: The way he presented himself in that movie was drastically different than the way he typically presents himself.
sentences.zh: 他在那部电影中呈现自己的方式与他平时的形象有着天壤之别。

sentences.en: And at the Oscars, like Javier Bardem, you know, is a very attractive man, right?
sentences.zh: 而在奥斯卡上，就像哈维尔·巴登，你知道的，是一个非常吸引人的男人，对吧？

sentences.en: And very handsome, warm, you know, he transformed himself physically for that role.
sentences.zh: 非常帅气，热情，你知道的，他为了那个角色在体形上做出了颠覆性的改变。

sentences.en: And it's really interesting because sometimes you think, I mean, that's the same person.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣，因为有时你会想，我的意思是，那是同一个人吗。

sentences.en: The person in the movie would not be someone that you would judge as attractive, right?
sentences.zh: 电影里的人绝不会是你认为有吸引力的人，对吧？

sentences.en: Not attractive.
sentences.zh: 毫无吸引力。

sentences.en: He's unattractive.
sentences.zh: 他很不讨喜。

sentences.en: And yet he, as an actor, is extremely attractive.
sentences.zh: 然而他作为一名演员，极具魅力。

sentences.en: I mean, really what this shows is that he was actually acting.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这真正表明的是他确实是在演戏。

sentences.en: He wasn't just playing himself.
sentences.zh: 他不仅仅是在本色出演。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: He was actually acting.
sentences.zh: 他确实是在演戏。

sentences.en: And when I first saw it, I was like, that's the way he looks.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次看到时，我想，他长得就是那个样子。

sentences.en: But it was part of how he acted that gave off this impression of who he was.
sentences.zh: 但正是他的一言一行，塑造了别人对他的这种整体印象。

sentences.en: I asked Vivian why we draw such sweeping conclusions from the faces we see.
sentences.zh: 我问维维安，为什么我们会从看到的面孔中得出如此极端的结论。

sentences.en: I think that as social beings, we want to make sense of this world that we're in.
sentences.zh: 我认为，作为社会性动物，我们总是试图去理解我们所处的这个世界。

sentences.en: And the social world is highly complex.
sentences.zh: 而社交世界是高度复杂的。

sentences.en: And so we want to make a prediction of who is it that we're interacting with.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们想要预测我们正在和什么样的人互动。

sentences.en: And so we use these cues that we see to make predictions.
sentences.zh: 所以我们会利用所看到的这些线索来进行预测。

sentences.en: And it kind of simplifies the world for us.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上为我们简化了世界。

sentences.en: Most of us know that discriminating against people on the basis of race or gender or sexual orientation is wrong.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人都知道，基于种族、性别或性取向对他人进行歧视是错误的。

sentences.en: But it's harder to be outraged by the beauty bias, even though it can have pernicious effects in the world.
sentences.zh: 但要对“美貌偏见”感到愤怒要难得多，尽管它在现实世界中会产生有害的影响。

sentences.en: That's because when we stare adoringly at movie stars and music icons, this bias doesn't feel like a negative thing.
sentences.zh: 这是因为，当我们深情地凝视电影明星和音乐偶像时，这种偏见并不让人觉得是一件负面的事。

sentences.en: It feels positive, even joyous.
sentences.zh: 它感觉是积极的，甚至是令人愉悦的。

sentences.en: When we come back, how appearances influence our interactions with others,
sentences.zh: 广告之后，我们将探讨外表如何影响我们与他人的互动，

sentences.en: affect our relationships, and shape the most important decisions in our lives.
sentences.zh: 影响我们的关系，并塑造我们生活中最重要的决策。

sentences.en: The halo effect is that when we judge someone to be attractive,
sentences.zh: 光环效应是指，当我们认为某人很有吸引力时，

sentences.en: we go beyond their physical appearance

sentences.en: So some years ago, Vivian, you brought people into the lab and you showed them photographs.

sentences.zh: 随后他们再次来到实验室，

sentences.en: and we told them that they were going to do a task where we were going to show them photographs of strangers and that they were just going to make their snap judgment.

sentences.en: They were going to assess whether they thought the person was trustworthy or not, attractive or not, intelligent or not, competent or not.

sentences.en: But what they didn't know is that we had taken the photographs of their partner, and we had morphed them with the photographs of another participant's partner.

sentences.en: People thought they were simply rating pictures of random strangers.

sentences.en: What they didn't know is that half of those pictures had been altered.

sentences.en: Vivian and her team morphed photographs of strangers with photographs of people's own romantic partners.
